notes: Western Jin writer 陸機 with matching AD 261–303 literary career.
English Lu Ji / Lü Ji covers 陸機 versus 盧惎, 陸勣/陸績, and 呂伋.
Both name Western Jin writer 陸機 around AD 303.
陸機 is distinct from 盧惎, 陸勣, 呂伋, and 陸績, which share only the English string Lu Ji.
